direction: The window follows new text only while the person is at the bottom; once they scroll away, only they move the view.
dont_over_correct: Do not stop following for everyone: a person who stays at the bottom should see new text without touching anything (counter-metric in section 7). Do not turn following off on layout-driven scroll events, images loading, or code blocks expanding; only user input counts (rule 7). Do not remove streaming or hide the reply until it ends. Do not make "Jump to latest" steal focus or move the view by itself.

prompt.not_applicable: The fix is enforced in the chat widget, not the prompt.

design: Keep one `following` flag per chat window.
Turn following off on the first user scroll up
While following is off, streamed content never changes the scroll position.
Turn following back on only by the person's action
On send, show the person's own message.
Keep browser scroll anchoring on for the message list.
Optional, test with users: anchor long replies at their start.

code.not_applicable: The fix lives in the chat widget; no package helper applies.

setup_questions: Can your agent supply these fields: reply.stream_start, reply.chunk, reply.stream_end, scroll.user, scroll.programmatic, jump_to_latest.shown, jump_to_latest.click, message.send?
Where does the fix go in your agent: the chat widget?

evals.behaviour: Reader stays at the bottom: Keep one `following` flag, on when a reply starts at the bottom
evals.pass_if: `reply.stream_start`, then `scroll.programmatic reason=chunk` follows the stream to the end. No `scroll.user`. `jump_to_latest.shown` does not appear.
evals.fail_if: The view stops following a reader who never scrolled

evals.behaviour: Do nothing special: a short reply: Don't over-correct: a reader who stays at the bottom keeps following
evals.pass_if: No `scroll.user`, no button, and no overridden scroll-up. The reply is visible when it ends.
evals.fail_if: Following turned off for everyone, the button shown to a bottom reader, or streaming removed

guardrail.not_applicable: Scroll position lives in the chat widget; the agent's server never sees it.
